Non-classical monocytes (CD16+).description: Non-classical CD16+ monocytes are patrolling monocytes that survey the endothelium and produce pro-inflammatory cytokines upon activation.

NK cells.description: Natural killer cells are cytotoxic lymphocytes that provide innate immune responses to infected or transformed cells.

Switched memory B cell.description: Memory B cell that has undergone class switch recombination, expressing surface IgG, IgA, or IgE, and CD27.

Unswitched memory B cell.description: Memory B cell retaining IgD and IgM, often associated with marginal zone, expressing CD27.

Double-negative memory B cell.description: Memory B cell lacking CD27 and surface IgD, often expanded in autoimmunity and aging, expressing CD11c and T-bet.

Plasmablast/plasma cell.description: Antibody-secreting cell, characterized by high expression of MZB1, XBP1, SDC1, and low CD20.

CD8+ TEMRA cell.description: Terminal effector memory T cell re-expressing CD45RA, with low CD27 and strong cytotoxic effector molecules.
